decls.description: A payment as the ledger records it. Origin: an observation, the ledger export of the finance department. Sealed on its booking date: once a month is closed, a late or changed row is refused by name and does not count.
The close of the ledger up to a date. Origin: a decision of the finance department. It names every payment it closes with the hash of its row, as `rezono_compiler close` writes it.

slots.description: Every payment booked before this date is closed.

decls.description: A closed payment, with the hash of its row when it was closed.

module.description: The payment ledger of the finance department, as a reference source: what another system recorded, kept apart from the scheme. No award reads it. A calculation rule compares it with the awards the rules derive, and the difference is drift, shown to readers with its proof.
